predecessor_preserved_findings.positive_narrow_result: Within the tested role-local repository scope, a nominally two-object outcome can avoid split-effect atomicity when exactly one immutable intent is correctness-critical and the second object is a deterministic, non-authoritative, reconstructible projection. predecessor_preserved_findings.unresolved_child: A genuinely independent second correctness-critical repository/external effect still retains split-effect atomicity.
predecessor_preserved_findings.architecture_hypothesis: One immutable intent/event can be the sole correctness-critical material record when all additional views are deterministic, reconstructible, non-authoritative projections.

selected_leaf: Crash-window Stage A for the sole-authoritative-record architecture: create and exact-read one immutable intent while intentionally leaving its deterministic derived view absent, then checkpoint before materialization.

source_qualified_precedent.title: Event Sourcing Pattern - Azure Architecture Center
source_qualified_precedent.relevant_contract: An append-only event stream can be the system of record; current state and materialized views can be regenerated by replaying events, with idempotent consumers required for repeated delivery.
source_qualified_precedent.scope: Architectural precedent only; no Azure service is part of this Phase-1 route.

bounded_leaf_result.semantic_claim: Within the exact role-local repository test scope, the sole correctness-critical immutable intent can be durably committed and exact-read while its deterministic non-authoritative projection remains absent at the invocation checkpoint. bounded_leaf_result.falsification_boundary: No claim is made for a genuinely independent second correctness-critical or external effect. Stage A alone does not prove cross-invocation recoverability; it only leaves the authoritative record durable with the projection absent.
